full_judgment: 20. PW.5 Nannu Howlader stated in his deposition that he knew the informant who was his neighbour. He also knew the deceased. The occurrence took place on 23.3.2003 at about 10-30 at night He crossed the ferry at 10-15 at night and disembarked at Khalishakhaii. They were 10/12 persons in number including deceased Harun and PW.2 Faisal. The deceased disembarked first; then he disembarked. Their houses being towards the same direction they were proceeding ahead on the same path. He, however, fell behind a little. When deceased Harun Gazi and PW.2 Faisal reached in the middle of the road running from east to west accused Tipu, Moti, Sahel, Mizanur, Yusuf. Sarder, Kalam, son of Eraf Ali, Faruk, Kalam member, Rustam Gazi, Delwar Gazi and several other persons dragged away the deceased on the road beside the nursery of Montu Mia and started chopping him (deceased) with ram dao and gaskata dao which they had in their hands. He witnessed the occurrence in the light of the electricity and also in the flash of the electric torch in his hand. Addressing accused Moti Gazi when he asked him why he was so chopping him (the deceased) he cried. out sayings ধর শালারে. Some accused who were standing on the road also chased him. He ran and entered into his dwelling house and narrated the occurrence to the inmates of his house. They did not allow him to come outside for rescue of the deceased. He further stated that when PW.2 Faisal, his grandmother (PW.4 Lal Vanu), grandfather (PW.1 Mokbul Gazi), father (PW. 3 Jahirul Islam) and other members of their family advanced (towards the place of occurrence) he followed them. On reaching the place of occurrence he found that the injured (deceased) was being carried towards the ferry ghat. He was in a state of dying and was also groaning. They took him by a trawler to the hospital where the doctor declared him dead. He made statement to the investigating officer. He identified accused Rustam Gazi, Delwar Gazi, Yusuf, Kalam Son of Eraf Ali on the dock and further stated that he recognized them. In his cross examination he stated that his dwelling house was one-fourth kilometre away from the nursery of Montu Mia. About 50/60 dwelling houses fell on way from the place of occurrence to his house. The inmates of those houses namely Noor Alam Master, Satter Gazi, Yunus Howlader, Malek Mia were the influential persons of the locality. In their own homestead also lived 10/12 members of four families. He further stated that he, his brother Sultan (PW.6), Shanu and Rustam Hawlader were the head of the said four families. After narrating the first occurrence to the inmates of his house he again paced towards the place of occurrence within 5/7 minutes. Many people came out in the said night on hearing their hue and cry. He did not, however, look at their face. In the night of occurrence he also accompanied the informant (PW.1) upto the, hospital. FIR was lodged on 24.3.2003. He was not aware of the number of the accused mentioned in the FIR. He further stated that he had communication with the police after one moth of the occurrence. His electric torch was deposited with the police. He did not remember the day on which he deposited the same. He admitted that he was a co accused with the deceased in G.R.No. 203 of 1996. he denied the defence suggestion that he did not witness the occurrence after crossing the ferry. He denied to have deposed a falsehood at the instance Habibur member. He further stated that accused Sikander and Yusuf were father and son. He was not aware if they purchased any land by means of patta from the informant. Accused Kalam was living in the land of, the informant by raising a dwelling hut there. He was not aware if the informant executed any deed in favour of accused Kalam over the said land. He denied the defence suggestion that the informant and the said accused had dispute in connection with the said land or that for that reason he falsely implicated them. He admitted that both he and the deceased moved together. He denied the defence suggestion that he did not witness the occurrence or that he deposed a falsehood at the asking of the informant.
